theorem{
 name: onlyEmptyRemainingPlanCanEnterStoreWrite,
 parameters: [config : EnvironmentPlanCommand::Config, store : (List EnvironmentMemory::Observation)],
 statement: ((EnvironmentPlanCommand::nextSource config store (nil EnvironmentPlan::Source)) = (match (EnvironmentMemory::serialize store) | Option.none => (EnvironmentPlanCommand::error "memory cannot be serialized within durable byte budget") | Option.some data => ((ctor EnvironmentPlanCommand::State.writing config data), (ctor LexLeanStd.Host::Request.write (EnvironmentPlanCommand::path config "/observations.pending") data)))), proof: reflexivity{}, axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
theorem{
 name: remainingSourceStartsOwnedAcquisitionBeforeWrite,
 parameters: [config : EnvironmentPlanCommand::Config, store : (List EnvironmentMemory::Observation), source : EnvironmentPlan::Source, remaining : (List EnvironmentPlan::Source)],
 statement: ((EnvironmentPlanCommand::nextSource config store (cons source remaining)) = (let result : (EnvironmentAcquisition::State * EnvironmentAcquisition::Emission) := (EnvironmentAcquisition::begin (EnvironmentPlanCommand::acquisitionConfig config source)); (match (second result) | EnvironmentAcquisition::Emission.host request => ((ctor EnvironmentPlanCommand::State.acquiring config store source remaining (first result)), request) | EnvironmentAcquisition::Emission.failed reason => (EnvironmentPlanCommand::error reason) | EnvironmentAcquisition::Emission.complete item => (EnvironmentPlanCommand::error "unexpected immediate acquisition completion")))), proof: reflexivity{}, axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
theorem{

}

}
theorem{
 name: queryUsesOnlyStoredContext,
 parameters: [home : String, task : Research::Task, query : Bytes, sources : (List EnvironmentPlan::Source), store : (List EnvironmentMemory::Observation)],
 statement: ((EnvironmentPlanCommand::useStore (record EnvironmentPlanCommand::Config {home := home, plan := (record EnvironmentPlan::Plan {ingest := false, task := task, query := query, sources := sources})}) store) = (EnvironmentPlanCommand::finish (record EnvironmentPlanCommand::Config {home := home, plan := (record EnvironmentPlan::Plan {ingest := false, task := task, query := query, sources := sources})}) store)), proof: term_cases{scrutinee: (ctor EnvironmentPlanCommand::State.ended), definitions: [EnvironmentPlanCommand::useStore]}, axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
